text:
sam: Hey team — exec demo with AcmeCorp tomorrow 11:00am PT, they want a short live demo using our hosted API. Need a temporary spike in hosted qps/quota for ~2 hours. Can eng provision a scoped key and bump limits?

maria: @sam can you confirm expected QPS and token volume? Also whether the client needs IP-restricted key or just time-limited?

sam: Expecting short bursts during interactive demo, peak ~400 qps, sustained ~150 qps, total tokens ~1.2M over 2 hours. Prefer time-limited scoped key (no infra work on their side). IP restriction not required.

alex: FYI we normally default to 50 qps on hosted POC keys. 400 qps is large but doable as a temporary burst if we gate it to short TTL and mark as emergency. Need approval from runtime and security.

jeff: @alex I can allocate a temporary quota increase up to 500 qps for 4 hours if we create a scoped key and tag it `poc:acmecorp:exec-demo`. We should also set a per-minute cap to avoid accidental hot loops.

sara: Security ok with time-limited scoped key if it's created with least privilege and audited. Please: (1) use an ephemeral key name, (2) enable request logging, (3) add an owners list. No customer-managed certs needed.

sam: Great — owners: @sam and @maria. Can you create key with TTL 4h and qps 450 and per-minute cap 20k tokens? Also need guidance on cost.

maria: Quick pricing note: hosted burst over base is billed at on-demand rate. For a 2-hour demo this is minor, but if it becomes recurring we should discuss a short-term committed block.

alex: I'll ask runtime to create a key template. JEFF: can you run the provisioning command below?

jeff: running now. command I used for similar:
```
redwoodctl keys create --name "poc-acme-exec" --scopes "text.generate" --qps 450 --burst-ttl 4h --token-cap 20000 --tag "poc:acmecorp"
```
Will return the key fingerprint, not the full secret in slack.

deploy-bot: Key creation request received. Ticket #INF-2917 created.

alex: Also adding a fallback route: if hosted capacity throttles, route to smaller model (redwood-small) with higher latency tolerance. Add `route: fallback=redwood-small` in the key metadata.

sara: Approving the plan. Make sure to redact the key in all recordings and zap logs after demo. Audit log retention for this key should be 90 days.

sam: @jeff once the key exists can you DM it to me and @maria? We will add it to the demo laptop and to the runbook.

jeff: Done — key created with fingerprint `kf_9d3f...` and TTL 4h. I DMed the secret to @sam and @maria. Applied per-minute token cap and fallback route.

maria: I'll update the CRM and the POC ticket with quota numbers and cost estimate.

alex: Monitoring: I'll add a short dashboard and an alert if token usage > 75% of the provisioned cap so we can scale down or cut demo.

sam: Perfect. Big :thumbsup: — will confirm with AcmeCorp and run pre-demo smoke at 9:30am PT.

jeff: One more note — if we need longer term or repeated demos, recommend provisioning a dedicated pool for predictable latency; ping me and I'll open a trial Dedicated request.

maria: Noted. Closing the loop here. All set unless someone objects.

sara: No objections.

sam: Closing thread, thanks everyone :rocket:
